name: Astral Hero
body:
Prerequisites: 5th-level aegis, at least 2 levels in non-aegis classes.

Benefit: You gain reconfigure +1/day.

If you are an 11th-level or higher aegis, you improve your damage reduction by +1/–. At 20th level, you improve your augment suit by 1.
